Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1953048 - Port bug 1949720: Fix repackage-macosx64/opt on production branches. r=thunderbird-build-system-reviewers,coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D240968

diff --git a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/hardened_signing.py b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/hardened_signing.py
index 3b0ec000593..23834350e57 100644
--- a/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/hardened_signing.py
+++ b/taskcluster/comm_taskgraph/transforms/hardened_signing.py
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@ This file is modified from the gecko_taskgraph transform by removing
 the provisioning profile portion.
 """
 
+import copy
+
 from taskgraph.transforms.base import TransformSequence
 from taskgraph.util.dependencies import get_primary_dependency
 from taskgraph.util.keyed_by import evaluate_keyed_by
@@ -25,6 +27,7 @@ def add_hardened_sign_config(config, jobs):
             continue
 
         dep_job = get_primary_dependency(config, job)
+        assert dep_job
         project_level = release_level(config.params["project"])
         is_shippable = dep_job.attributes.get("shippable", False)
         hardened_signing_type = "developer"
@@ -34,20 +37,31 @@ def add_hardened_sign_config(config, jobs):
         if project_level == "production" and is_shippable:
             hardened_signing_type = "production"
 
-        evaluated = evaluate_keyed_by(
-            config.graph_config["mac-signing"]["hardened-sign-config"],
+        # Evaluating can mutate the original config, so we must deepcopy
+        hardened_sign_config = evaluate_keyed_by(
+            copy.deepcopy(config.graph_config["mac-signing"]["hardened-sign-config"]),
             "hardened-sign-config",
             {"hardened-signing-type": hardened_signing_type},
         )
-        if not isinstance(evaluated, list):
+        if not isinstance(hardened_sign_config, list):
             raise Exception("hardened-sign-config must be a list")
 
-        for sign_cfg in evaluated:
+        for sign_cfg in hardened_sign_config:
+            if isinstance(sign_cfg.get("entitlements"), dict):
+                sign_cfg["entitlements"] = evaluate_keyed_by(
+                    sign_cfg["entitlements"],
+                    "entitlements",
+                    {
+                        "build-platform": dep_job.attributes.get("build_platform"),
+                        "project": config.params["project"],
+                    },
+                )
+
             if "entitlements" in sign_cfg and not sign_cfg.get("entitlements", "").startswith(
                 "http"
             ):
                 sign_cfg["entitlements"] = config.params.file_url(sign_cfg["entitlements"])
 
-        job["worker"]["hardened-sign-config"] = evaluated
+        job["worker"]["hardened-sign-config"] = hardened_sign_config
         job["worker"]["mac-behavior"] = "mac_sign_and_pkg_hardened"
         yield job
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/repackage-l10n/kind.yml

@@ -32,12 +32,12 @@ tasks:
         from-deps:
             group-by: single-with-filters
         upstream-mac-kind:
-            by-build-type:
-                debug: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
-                default:
-                    by-project:
-                        comm-(central|beta|release|esr.*): shippable-l10n-mac-notarization
-                        default: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
+            by-build-platform:
+                macosx64-shippable:
+                    by-release-level:
+                        production: shippable-l10n-mac-notarization
+                        staging: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
+                default: shippable-l10n-mac-signing
         worker-type: 'b-linux-gcp'
         mozharness:
             comm-checkout: true
